About The Company

Smart Pension is a pioneering financial technology company dedicated to transforming retirement, savings, and financial wellbeing across all generations worldwide. We collaborate with governments and financial institutions to develop innovative, cloud-native digital platforms that revolutionize how people save for their future. Our mission is rooted in leveraging digital change to put the customer at the center of financial solutions, ensuring accessible, scalable, and efficient services. At Smart, we foster a culture of continuous innovation, collaboration, and inclusion, empowering our team members to make a meaningful impact on financial outcomes for savers globally. Our commitment to technological excellence and customer-centricity positions us as leaders in the fintech industry, shaping the future of retirement planning and financial security.

About The Role

As a Business Analyst at Smart Pension, you will play a vital role in supporting our strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing our operational model and delivering superior customer experiences. Your primary responsibilities will include defining, developing, and documenting end-to-end business processes, providing technical input during user acceptance testing, and executing operational readiness checklists. You will engage effectively with internal teams and third-party stakeholders at various levels to facilitate change and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, with a keen focus on execution and delivery. You will support our growth by collaborating across departments to optimize opportunities for cost reduction, risk management, scalability, and customer satisfaction. Your work will directly contribute to our mission of transforming financial wellbeing on a global scale.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess relevant experience in the DC pensions industry, complemented by professional certifications in business analysis. A Lean Six Sigma accreditation is highly desirable, demonstrating your expertise in process improvement methodologies. You should have demonstrable experience in business analysis, process management, and requirements gathering, with the ability to create comprehensive documentation tailored to technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working within an agile environment is preferred, along with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills are essential, enabling you to build trusted relationships across various levels of the organization. A flexible approach to changing business needs, combined with a proactive attitude and accountability, will ensure your success in this role.

Responsibilities

Develop a comprehensive understanding of existing processes and product offerings to identify gaps and support future developments.
Demonstrate expert knowledge of the platform, products, and operational procedures.
Document change requests with clear, data-supported business cases to facilitate informed decision-making.
Foster and maintain strong working relationships across internal teams and external partners.
Facilitate workshops to gather stakeholder insights, analyze requirements, and accurately define business needs.
Create detailed documentation to support approval processes and project delivery activities.
Translate business requirements into detailed user stories to guide development and testing teams.
Design process flows that map out core business operations and identify areas for improvement.
Produce cost and risk analyses to evaluate initiatives and support benefit realization, considering all potential gains.
Collect and analyze management information to inform strategic decisions.
Provide technical input during user acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business needs.
Set and execute operational readiness checklists, obtaining sign-off from key stakeholders prior to implementation.
Assess and mitigate emerging risks, ensuring compliance and operational stability.
Communicate technical issues effectively to stakeholders using appropriate business language.
Resolve complex issues by applying commercial and business awareness, ensuring timely resolution.
Develop a thorough understanding of third-party partner capabilities and technologies.
Engage with business strategy discussions, understanding their impact on team operations and customer outcomes.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement focused on enhancing customer experience and managing operational costs.
Lead and facilitate change initiatives, demonstrating personal commitment and inspiring team members to adapt and thrive.

Benefits

25 days of annual holiday, increasing with tenure.
£500 annual training budget to support your professional development.
Extensive private healthcare coverage, including dental, eye care, and Employee Assistance Program.
Enhanced sick leave entitlement, offering up to three months’ pay per year.
Enhanced maternity and paternity leave, with six months’ fully paid maternity leave and three weeks’ fully paid paternity leave.
Death in service insurance coverage for peace of mind.
Fully-paid five-week sabbatical after five years of continuous employment.
Wellbeing initiatives within the office, such as massages, manicures, and barber services.
50% discount on orders from Arena Flowers, our sister company specializing in ethical floral arrangements and gifts.

Equal Opportunity

Smart Pension is committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and excellence, and we actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities. We do not discriminate based on protected characteristics and are dedicated to providing reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process and in the workplace. Our goal is to create a supportive environment where all employees can thrive and contribute to our mission of transforming retirement, savings, and financial wellbeing worldwide.

Serving as the primary coordinator for major case investigations and analysis. Providing proactive and innovative solutions to complex analytical challenges. Initiating new reports and other analytics products and services in anticipation of requests or suggested trends.

Utilizing investigative techniques, data mining, crime mapping, statistics, research methods, desktop publishing, charting, presentation skills, and critical thinking. Developing and maintaining products and processes to support the needs of the MPD's Crime Briefing meetings and other tactical, operational, and strategic briefings.

Persistent Systems is a leading global technology services company dedicated to delivering innovative solutions across various industries, including healthcare, finance, and enterprise applications. About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst specializing in healthcare data to join our dynamic team at Persistent Systems. In this role, you will be instrumental in analyzing complex healthcare datasets, developing data models, and supporting analytics initiatives that drive strategic decision-making. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including healthcare operations, clinical, finance, and compliance, to translate raw data into meaningful insights. Your expertise in SQL, healthcare data modeling, and integration will be vital in building scalable cloud-based infrastructure, automating system health checks, and enhancing data quality and reporting accuracy. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful healthcare projects, improve operational efficiencies, and support value-based care initiatives.

Qualifications

To succeed in this role, candidates should possess a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, healthcare analytics, statistics, or a related field. A minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience working with US healthcare datasets, including claims, benefits, and eligibility data, is required. Strong proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large healthcare datasets is essential. Familiarity with modern data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake and MySQL, along with experience in healthcare process and data flow documentation, is highly desirable. Candidates should demonstrate excellent analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills, coupled with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Performing detailed healthcare data analysis and reporting, including working with large-scale US healthcare datasets such as claims, provider, utilization, and quality data.
Writing, optimizing, and validating complex SQL queries to extract insights from relational databases, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Supporting healthcare data modeling and integration efforts by collaborating with data engineering teams to facilitate reliable data ingestion from source systems like claims processing, provider systems, and eligibility feeds.
Developing and maintaining healthcare data marts, models, and analytics layers using platforms such as Snowflake and MySQL.
Engaging in analytics initiatives related to value-based care, population health management, quality improvement, and operational efficiency enhancements.
Creating process flows, data lineage diagrams, and system architecture visuals to document healthcare data workflows using tools like Microsoft Visio or draw.io.
